Lettuce.nursery_specific: Salanova (pelleted) lettuce seeds: use vacuum seeder with 128 or 72-cell trays. Non-pelleted lettuce seeds are very small and irregular — sow by hand or with small hand-held seeder. Use low-fertility potting mix (no compost) for germination. Watering regime: Stage 1 (germination) frequent with 1000-hole nozzle; Stage 2 (seedlings) as needed with 400-hole nozzle; Stage 3 (transplant-ready) less frequent, let surface dry. Spray weekly with seaweed or compost tea to inoculate with beneficial microorganisms.

Basil.nursery_specific: Small, irregular seeds require hand seeding or small hand-held seeder — vacuum seeder not suitable. Use low-fertility potting mix for germination. Group trays by cell count (128 with 128, 72 with 72) for uniform watering. Maintain humidity 65-80%.
